description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyIdNotAllowedException' within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.exceptions' package. The class is used to indicate an error situation where a 'Thing' contains a Policy ID which isn't permitted in this context. It includes static methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested Builder class for fluent creation of exceptions. The file references several other classes and interfaces related to exceptions, headers, JSON handling, and Thing identity.

classes.name: PolicyIdNotAllowedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a Thing contains a Policy ID when it shouldn't. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, providing additional static factory methods and a builder class for creating instances.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A static inner class providing a fluent API for constructing instances of PolicyIdNotAllowedException, initialized with optional message, description, cause, headers, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance initialized with a specific ThingId to generate a message including the Thing's ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyIdNotAllowedException from a given message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyIdNotAllowedException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides the method to set new headers, returning a new exception instance with the updated headers.
